# stagetui

> Rust-first TUI engine with a thin, typed Python API. Built for coding agents to build, see and test terminal apps (agent harnesses first), and for humans to get friendly terminal UIs. Linux, macOS, Windows. Zero Python runtime dependencies.

Status: Milestone 5 (harness kit, Blender-style panes, workspaces, background sessions, pop-out pane windows, agent interface). APIs below exist today; media plugins (M6) are planned.

## Python API
- `import stagetui as ts`
- `ts.show(content, *, title, icon, dir, theme, accent, width, height, fit)` — inline text card or picture (path, bytes, Canvas).
- `ts.draw(fn=None, *, size=(640,360), background=None, out=None, show=True) -> Canvas` — draw with code.
- `ts.inspect(*, headless=False, probe=True) -> dict`; `ts.fonts() -> dict`.
- `class StageApp` — class attrs `theme`, `accent`, `dir`, `BINDINGS=[(key, action[, description])]`, `reduce_motion`; override `compose() -> list[widget]`, optional `on_mount()`, `action_<name>()`.
  - `.run()` / `await .run_async()` — interactive; q / Esc / Ctrl+C quit; handlers may be `async def`.
  - `.run_headless((cols, rows), *, steps=[{"press": "tab"}, {"type": "hi"}, {"click": "#id"}, {"drag": {"from": "#id" or [x, y], "to": [x, y]}}, {"scroll": 3}, {"wait": 0.5}, {"wait_idle": True}, {"resize": [w, h]}], cell=(16, 32), settle=True) -> Snapshot` — virtual clock, deterministic.
  - Snapshot: `.text` (reading order), `.tree` (nested JSON: id, type, bounds, focused, on_screen, children; app `focus`, `dir`, `scroll`, `toasts`), `.png`, `.query("#id")`, `.save("x.png|.txt|.json")`.
  - `.query("#id")`, `.focused`, `.focused_pane`, `.notify(text, icon=, accent=, timeout=)`, `.set_theme(name)`, `.mount(widget)`, `.exit()`.
- Containers: `Stage(children, direction="vertical"|"horizontal", columns=, gap=, align=)`, `StageSplit(children, direction="horizontal", ratio=[...])` (draggable dividers), `StageTabs(children, active=, on_change=)` (page title/icon from children), `StageModal(children, title=, dismissable=, on_close=)` (hidden until `.show()`), `StageBar(text)` (status + BINDINGS hints).
- Display: `StageCard(text, shadow=)`, `StageText(text)`, `StageImage(path|bytes|Canvas, width=, height=, fit=)`, `StageCanvas(draw_fn=None, size=(w_px, h_px), on_frame=fn(canvas, t), fps=30)`.
- Controls: `StageButton(label, on_click=, icon=, variant="secondary"|"primary"|"danger")`, `StageInput(value, placeholder=, title=, password=, on_change=, on_submit=)`, `StageCheckbox(label, checked=, on_change=)`, `StageSelect(options, value=, on_change=)`, `StageProgress(0..1|None, label=)`, `StageSpinner(label)`, `StageTable(rows, headers=, height=, on_select=, on_submit=)`, `StageTree(dict|list, on_select=, on_submit=)`.
- Harness: `StageChat(messages)` → `.add(role, text) -> msg` (`msg.append(chunk)`, `msg.update(text)`), `.add_tool(name, args) -> msg` (`msg.finish(output, ok=True)`), `.clear()`; `StageMarkdown(text)` `.append()`; `StagePrompt(text, placeholder=, commands=[(name, desc)], mentions=[files], on_submit=)` (Enter sends, Shift/Alt+Enter or Ctrl+J newline, ↑/↓ history, / and @ completion); `StageCode(source, language=, path=)`, `StageCode.from_file(p)`; `StageDiff((old, new), path=, on_decide=)` (a/r/A keys, `.accept_all()`, `.result`); `StageToolCall(name, args=)` `.finish()`; `StagePermission(question, tool=, args=, on_decide=)`; `await app.ask_permission(q, tool=, args=) -> "allow"|"always"|"deny"`; `StageTerminal(command="", cwd=)` `.send(text)`, `.screen`; `StageLog(text, max_lines=)` `.append()`, `.filter()`.
- Panes: `StagePane(type, **options)` types chat, terminal(command, cwd), files(root), diff(old, new, path), code(path|text, language), markdown(text), log, empty; header menu (click title / prefix+Space), ⊞ ⊟ × buttons; `.set_type(type, **o)`, `.switch(type)` (restores stashed), `.type`, `.content`; `app.panes()`; `@ts.pane_type(name, title=, icon=)`; prefix key `PREFIX="ctrl+space"` then Space | - x Tab q, d (detach), 1-9 (workspace).
- Workspaces: `StageWorkspaces({"Code": layout, ...})` tabs; `app.workspace()` → layout dict `{"split": "horizontal", "ratio": [..], "children": [{"pane": type, "id": id, "args": {...}} | {"keep": id} | split]}`; `app.save_workspace(name=None, path=None)`, `app.load_workspace(name_or_layout=None, path=None)` (re-uses panes by id), `app.workspaces()`; files in ~/.config/stagetui/workspaces/<app>.json.
- Sessions: `app.session`, `ts.sessions()`, `app.background(coro)`. q in an attached window asks Detach / Quit app / Cancel.
- Video add-on (`pip install stagetui-video`): `StagePane("video", path|url=..., autoplay, loop, volume, muted, start, on_ended=, on_state=)`; keys space/←→/↑↓/m/home; `pane.content.call("play"|"pause"|"toggle"|"seek", n|"volume", v|"mute", b|"state")`.
- Web add-on (`pip install stagetui-web`): `StagePane("web", url|path=..., zoom, on_title=, on_navigated=, on_loaded=)`; uses the installed Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave (headless); keys go to the page, Ctrl+L address, Alt+←/→, F5; `pane.content.call("navigate", url|"back"|"forward"|"reload"|"evaluate", js|"state")`.
- 3D add-on (`pip install stagetui-3d`): `StagePane("3d", path="model.glb|.gltf|.obj|.stl", spin=True, wireframe=False, grid=True, up="y"|"z", on_loaded=)`; drawn on the CPU; drag turns, right-drag moves, wheel zooms; keys arrows/+/-/space/w/g/f/r; `pane.content.call("load", path|"view", {yaw, pitch, distance}|"spin"|"wireframe"|"grid", bool|"reset"|"save", "view.png"|"state")`.
- Add-ons: `StagePane("video", path=...)` / `StagePlugin(name, **opts, on_<event>=...)`; programs `stagetui-plugin-<name>` (next to Python, STAGETUI_PLUGIN_PATH, PATH); write one in Python with `stagetui.plugin.Plugin` + `serve()` (frame(t) returns a Canvas), or Rust crate `stagetui-plugin-api`; `ts.plugins()`; `stagetui plugins [install NAME]`; missing add-ons ask to install on first use; picture add-ons open in a picture terminal when the current one draws blocks.
- Pop-out: `widget.detach()` / `.attach()` (the pane holding it opens in its own terminal window / comes back), `pane.detached`, action `pop_out`, prefix then o, header ↗; window runs `stagetui attach app:pane`; `LAUNCHER = "foot {cmd}"` or `STAGETUI_LAUNCHER`.
- Every widget: `.update(content, **props)`, `.load(content)`, `.show()`, `.hide()`, `.focus()`, `.split(widget, direction=)`, `.remove()`, `.value`; containers `.add(widget)`.
- `Canvas(width, height, background)`: clear, rect, rounded_rect, circle, line, polyline, gradient_rect, gradient_circle, text (shaped Arabic/Hindi), image, png, save.
- `Style(padding=, rounded=, accent=, shadow=, width=, height=, grow=)`, `@ts.component` (returns a widget or a list), `ts.StageError` (`.what`, `.why`, `.fix`).

Universal props: id, theme ("aurora-dark" | "nordic-light" | "velvet-dusk" | "paper-soft" | "hacker-mint"), accent ("blue" | "mint" | "amber" | "rose" | "violet" | "#rrggbb"), rounded, padding ("compact" | "normal" | "spacious" | int), icon, dir ("auto" | "ltr" | "rtl"), animate ("none" | "fade" | "slide-up" | "slide-left" | "pulse" | "pop"), visible, width/height (cells or "50%"), grow.

Built-in actions: quit, next_theme, focus_next, focus_previous, close_modal, pane_menu, split_pane_right, split_pane_down, close_pane. Keys: "ctrl+s", "ctrl+shift+d", "alt+x", "f1", "enter", "esc", "tab", "pageup", "?", "ctrl+backslash".

Colors (canvas): "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa", accent names, "white", "black", "gray", "red", "transparent".

Icons: sparkles, check, x, play, pause, stop, globe, book, cube, sun, moon, terminal, star, bolt, info, warning, folder, file, chat, code, gear, heart, send, arrow-right, arrow-left, plus, minus, dot, circle, home.

## Agent interface
- `stagetui mcp app.py [--size 100x30]` — MCP server (stdio). Tools: snapshot(png?, settle?), press(key|keys), type(text), click(target|x,y), drag(target|x,y, to_x, to_y), scroll(rows, target?), resize(cols, rows), wait(seconds), query(id), list_panes, set_pane_type(pane, type), workspace, load_workspace(layout|name), save_workspace(name). Each action returns the new screen text. Add to Claude Code: `claude mcp add my-app -- stagetui mcp /path/app.py`.
- `stagetui drive app.py` — JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON per line; methods snapshot, press, type, click, drag, scroll, resize, wait, wait_idle, query, panes, set_pane_type, workspace, load_workspace, save_workspace, shutdown.
- Python: `with App().drive((cols, rows)) as d: d.type(..); d.click("#id"); d.drag((x, y), (x2, y2)); d.snapshot(png=True)`; live apps: `app.capture_text()`, `capture_tree()`, `capture_png()`.
- pytest: fixture `stage_snapshot.assert_match(snap, name=None, png=False)`, refresh with `pytest --stage-update`.

## CLI
- `stagetui show <image|text> [--title --icon --dir --theme --accent --width --height --fit]`
- `stagetui render <app.py|image|text> [--out x.png] [--text x.txt] [--tree x.json] [--size 100x30] [--cell 16x32]`
- `stagetui inspect [--compact] [--headless] [--no-probe]` — JSON capabilities
- `stagetui doctor` — plain-English report with fixes
- `stagetui drive app.py` / `stagetui mcp app.py` — agent interface (above)
- `stagetui start app.py [--name N] [-d] [-- args]`, `stagetui sessions [--json]`, `stagetui attach [name[:pane]]`, `stagetui stop [name]` — background sessions; Ctrl+Space d detaches
- `python -m stagetui …` — same CLI
